marker_rule: A marker stands at the published seat (headquarters) of a grid operator the layer records — the institution's seat, never a measurement location. Grid readings carry no coordinates: an operator's territory is a region, not a point, and the record stores none. Where an operator's seat is not published by the operator, there is no marker.

markers.product: MISO Real Time Total Load (hourly Cleared MW)
ERCOT dashboard fuel mix (hourly generation by fuel, MW)
